description: 해양수산부 국립해양조사원_지역 해양기후 수치모델 기반 미래 해수면 상승 전망 조회 [sea level rise] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 해양수산부 국립해양조사원. 이 데이터는 해양수산부 국립해양조사원에서 IPCC 6차 평가보고서의 기후변화 시나리오를 따른 지역 해양기후 수치예측모델을 기반으로 전망된 해수면 상승 예측정보를 제공하기 위해 수집한. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 해양수산부 국립해양조사원. Its tags are 해양기후, 수치예측모델, 해수면, 기후변화, 해양환경. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-03-13 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
